project.name: JSON and YAML report
project.description: Inspect a JSON API payload and YAML configuration through retained native trees, filter service records and generate HTML, JSON and YAML reports with syntax failure and repair.

entries.name: Parse imported JSON tree
entries.description: Parse through the retained native import; present the common data tree with original source identity and ranges, without evaluating literal strings.

entries.name: Parse imported YAML tree
entries.description: Parse through the retained native import; present the common data tree with original source identity and ranges, without evaluating literal strings.

entries.name: Inspect imported JSON tree
entries.description: Inspect the retained generic-data CEM tree and original source offsets, rather than a format-specific source AST.

entries.name: Validate JSON source
entries.description: Validate native source syntax; this is not an authored application-schema instance check.

entries.name: Format JSON source
entries.description: Format saved source with the native package tabular profile without overwriting it.

entries.name: Select active API record IDs
entries.description: Select active record IDs using the saved standalone CEM-QL expression.

entries.name: Inspect imported YAML tree
entries.description: Inspect the retained generic-data CEM tree and original source offsets, rather than a format-specific source AST.

entries.name: Validate YAML source
entries.description: Validate native source syntax; this is not an authored application-schema instance check.

entries.name: Format YAML source
entries.description: Format saved source with the native package tabular profile without overwriting it.

entries.name: Inspect report settings
entries.description: Read title and status through the same retained generic-data projection as JSON.

entries.name: Repair malformed JSON
entries.description: Run to see the intentional native source diagnostic; README documents the exact repair.

entries.name: Repair malformed YAML
entries.description: Run to see the intentional native source diagnostic; README documents the exact repair.

entries.name: Build and preview report
entries.description: Filter saved JSON records using saved YAML settings; publish an HTML view and typed JSON/YAML arrays. Preview generated/report.html or a data table.
